projectState.summary: Claude approved codex/byte-song-library-a at b2daca6 and it was fast-forward merged/pushed to main. The merged arc adds the user song library, prompt-based starter composer, visible Generate starter seed, and active 16-beat prompt-seeded SongMaterial phrase packs for pulse/bass/melody. A new branch codex/byte-wild-song-draft-a has been created from the merged main at b2daca6 for the next bolder musical experiment. Arne wants to stop over-optimizing small safe layers and try offbeat but promising hunches with clean rollback. Candidate next hypothesis: use human-written scores/forms as landmarks, then generate/audition a whole temporary song draft at once with section lengths, harmonic progression, tempo regions, and per-player material rather than layering more modifiers on short loops.
